recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not delete the legacy ImagingManifest directory or historical OID mappings under this tracker without a broader cleanup decision about removed-resource source retention and historical identifier preservation.
issue_request: FHIR-12945 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from the Imaging Integration work group asking to remove the unused KOS title value set.
initial_application: The December 2017 commit d21acd48143d1cbe35a35616864c97839b13a361 explicitly mentioned GF#12945 and removed ImagingManifest from the active source/fhir.ini [resources] list, moving imagingmanifest to [removed-resources]. That eliminated the only active resource source that used the KOS title binding.
additional_context: FHIR-14080, applied in the same historical commit, removed ImagingManifest from FHIR because its primary IHE use case no longer used the resource. Current source/fhir.ini does not register kos-title in active [codesystems] or [valuesets]. Remaining kos-title references are under the legacy source/imagingmanifest directory, source/oids.ini historical identifier mappings, or tools/history release snapshots. FHIR-12947 was reviewed as background DICOM-derived terminology context but is a separate R5 value set consistency issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/build scope already satisfies the issue: valueset-kos-title and CodeSystem-kos-title are not active terminology inputs and are not published on build.fhir.org.

related_jiras.note: Removed ImagingManifest from FHIR, which eliminated the active resource usage of the KOS title value set.
